expected: A port-less bracketed IPv6 host (`ABC123@[::1]`) resolves to `wss://[::1]/ws`; a bracketed host carrying a port (`ABC123@[::1]:9000`) still resolves to `wss://[::1]:9000/ws`.
mechanism: parseJoinCode splits host:port on the LAST colon. For a bracketed IPv6 literal with no port, that colon is inside the address (e.g. `[::1]` -> colonIndex=3, hasPort=true), so host becomes `[:` and the join code resolves to the malformed, unconnectable `wss://[::1/ws`.
